description: This file defines the internal class GrainLocator, which provides methods for locating, registering, unregistering, and caching grain activations within an Orleans cluster. It interacts with a resolver to obtain specific grain locators based on grain type.

classes.name: GrainLocator
classes.description: Provides functionality for locating grain activations in a cluster, registering, unregistering, and managing cache invalidation for grain addresses.

methods.name: Lookup
methods.description: Asynchronously looks up the address of a grain by its ID.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a grain address, optionally replacing a previous registration.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a grain address with a specified cause.

methods.name: TryLookupInCache
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a grain address from cache.

methods.name: InvalidateCache (by GrainId)
methods.description: Invalidates cache entries for a specific grain ID.

methods.name: InvalidateCache (by GrainAddress)
methods.description: Invalidates cache entries for a specific grain address.

methods.name: GetGrainLocator
methods.description: Retrieves a specific grain locator for a given grain type.

methods.name: UpdateCache (by GrainId and SiloAddress)
methods.description: Updates the cache with a new silo address for a grain ID.

methods.name: UpdateCache (by GrainAddressCacheUpdate)
methods.description: Updates or invalidates cache based on a GrainAddressCacheUpdate object.
